results.n: L2 summons ONE clone (30 NP), Echo by default, behind the Ranger
a second L2 does NOT make a second clone (switches behaviour instead)
ECHO repeats the jab 14 f later from the clone's own spot and lands (normal hitbox / overlap)
an Echo far from the foe whiffs (no hit from across the screen)
switching Echo → Guard keeps lifetime, attack allowance and cooldown (only time passes)
GUARD sees the foe's attack, shows a telegraph ("!") and then counters
the Guard counter lands on the opening (damage)
→+L2 SWAP trades places with the clone and spends 1 Ninja Step charge
a swap onto the foe resolves collision (the Ranger never ends inside the foe)
no Ninja Step charge → no swap
←+L2 RECALL pulls the clone back in (shorter cooldown)
the clone never refills: lifetime only falls, allowance unchanged without attacks, it cannot summon
the clone dissolves at the end of its lifetime (cooldown starts)
